metadata.question: Does tropospheric nitrogen dioxide (NO2) levels in Chongqing, China increase during April 20-May 12, 2020 compared to February 10-25, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-5P OFFL L3 NO2 tropospheric column product for Chongqing, China. 2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed (this product is already cloud-screened and averaged daily); we just filter on date and region. 3. Logic: Compute mean tropospheric NO2 column for each period. Check collection sizes → C1 if no images, check pixel counts → C2 if 0 valid pixels. Compare averages: if mean2 > mean1 → A, else B. Validate for None/NaN → C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions chongqing = ee.Geometry.Point([106.5, 29.6]) # central Chongqing buff = chongqing.buffer(25000) # ~25 km radius feb10_25 = ('2020-02-10', '2020-02-25') apr20_may12 = ('2020-04-20', '2020-05-12') # 2. Data Acquisition def get_mean(dates): col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density') .filterDate(*dates) .filterBounds(buff)) n = col.size().getInfo() if n == 0: return None, 0 img = col.mean().clip(buff) cnt = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=buff, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo() mean = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=buff, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo() return mean, cnt mean1, cnt1 = get_mean(feb10_25) mean2, cnt2 = get_mean(apr20_may12) print(f"Feb 10-25 mean: {mean1}; pixels: {cnt1}; Apr 20-May12 mean: {mean2}; pixels: {cnt2}") if mean1 is None or mean2 is None: print("C1") elif cnt1 == 0 or cnt2 == 0: print("C2") elif mean1 is None or mean2 is None: print("C3") elif mean2 > mean1: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
chongqing = ee.Geometry.Point([106.5, 29.6])  # central Chongqing
buff = chongqing.buffer(25000)                 # ~25 km radius

feb10_25 = ('2020-02-10', '2020-02-25')
apr20_may12 = ('2020-04-20', '2020-05-12')

# 2. Data Acquisition
def get_mean(dates):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2')
             .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density')
             .filterDate(*dates)
             .filterBounds(buff))
    n = col.size().getInfo()
    if n == 0:
        return None, 0
    img = col.mean().clip(buff)
    cnt = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=buff, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
    mean = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=buff, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
    return mean, cnt

mean1, cnt1 = get_mean(feb10_25)
mean2, cnt2 = get_mean(apr20_may12)

print(f"Feb 10-25 mean: {mean1}; pixels: {cnt1}; Apr 20-May12 mean: {mean2}; pixels: {cnt2}")

if mean1 is None or mean2 is None:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif cnt1 == 0 or cnt2 == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif mean1 is None or mean2 is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif mean2 > mean1:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
